entities.summary: Blandine Merten was a German Ursulines. Merten worked as a teacher in a secular environment from 1902 to 1908. After taking her first vows, she continued teaching until 1916, when ill health forced her to retire. Pope John Paul II beatified her on 1 November 1987.
